_comment: How bad a dig gets. base/per_depth are the assault curves; surge is the surfacing burst. WHO comes out is not decided here: each hole's seep file declares its own fauna (config/seeps/). dig_site is the way down itself -- how close he must stand to be offered it, and how often an unfinished floor sends one up through it. bestiary is the derivation table for every species -- hp/contact/speed/xp derive from a creature's sheet (resistance/defensiveness/dispersal) the way the player's numbers derive from his (config/stats.json), and smell is the per-individual roll, hotter with depth, that multiplies all of it.
